title: Quarterly Financial Results
text:
CONFIDENTIAL - FINANCE ONLY. Third quarter revenue was 12.4 crore rupees with a net profit margin of 8.5 percent. Operating costs were 9.1 crore rupees.

Payroll disbursement account: AC-99120044-77, bank code FAKEBANK-0042. The board approved a hiring budget of 40 new roles for next year.
